title: Experience supports a gentle response
meaning: Considerate shared action draws on understood experience and is emotionally answered by a sense of gentle steadiness around a strong impulse.
text: Strength appears in different roles in this Energy Field. In the physical position, it describes considerate handling of a powerful impulse during shared actions; in emotions, it is a feeling of gentle steadiness, where the impulse remains alive without occupying the whole experience. The Hermit in energy gives a motive to draw on understood experience and communicate what has become clear. The overall tone may combine calm action with quiet satisfaction in how you handle tension together, using what earlier situations have taught you.

For example, you are once again assembling an unstable piece of camping equipment. Frustration with the fittings is familiar, and one person recalls a previously discovered sequence without reproach. You avoid taking parts out of each other’s hands and gradually feel that the urge to hurry no longer governs the whole task. **We remember our earlier experience and are handling the tension more gently now.** Satisfaction concerns both the assembled object and the feeling of being considerate beside another person.

A difficulty appears if a successful experience becomes a demand to maintain the same composure every time. Irritation must then be hidden to preserve an image of calm interaction. Strength’s two roles do not mean doubled endurance or an obligation to tolerate every inconvenience. The Hermit as motivation also does not make a past explanation final: a new situation may differ and produce another response in each person.
